listing.name: Ananke's Gift
listing.summary: Hello, I have returned from my modding hiatus to bring you all a pretty small mod:
listing.aiSummary: Adds a superdestroyer and a mission to unlock it, allowing players to fly a heavily modified capital ship.

description:
Hello, I have returned from my modding hiatus (briefly) to bring you all a pretty small mod:

Ananke's Gift as a standalone mod this time.

Well when I say standalone I mean *mostly* standalone as it does come with the other 2 bits from NAS and one or two hullmods, plus of course its component mission.

In any case, if you'd like to have a shot at flying a jacked up superdestroyer then this is the mod for you!

Note: You must complete The Gift mission from the main menu and then a start will be unlocked in the super category of Independents.

Requirements: Lazylib, Magiclib, Nexelerin

Download link:

https://mega.nz/file/FHoUVbxT#3ZW3-7fmAbFuGfXLLBFM2IzNXSOr3VbcMolQ_9RmbKI
